mapper.select: select p.permission_id, p.permission_code, p.permission_name, p.http_method, p.request_path, p.enabled from admin_permission p inner join admin_role_permission rp on rp.permission_id = p.permission_id inner join admin_user_role ur on ur.role_id = rp.role_id inner join admin_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where ur.admin_user_id = #{adminUserId} and p.enabled = 1 and r.enabled = 1
